review: 19 Nov source check: false story. Mahavira did NOT go 12 years without food or water: he broke fasts on about 325 of 4545 days (fasts of 2 days to 6 months); kevalgyan came during a 2-day fast under a sal tree by the Rijuvalika at Jrimbhikagram, not after a meal of kheer from a seth (source: Kishor B Shah, Oshwal UK, from Kalpasutra / Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra)
